name: fresh-converter
command: buildctl debug workers; find /input -maxdepth 2 -type f; mount | grep -E 'vda|vdb|vdc'; ip -brief addr

name: convert-metadata
local-base-multistage
command:
set -eu; printf %s 'ARG BASE=localhost/pinfold/local:latest
FROM ${BASE} AS inherited
FROM inherited AS final
COPY --from=localhost/pinfold/local:latest /owned /copied
RUN ["/bin/busybox", "sh", "-c", "/bin/busybox cat /copied; /bin/busybox printenv PHASE6_VALUE"]
' >/tmp/conversion/Dockerfile; buildctl build --frontend dockerfile.v0 --local context=/tmp/context --local dockerfile=/tmp/conversion --oci-layout localbase=/input --opt context:localhost/pinfold/local:latest=oci-layout://localbase@sha256:74d897e251664ee57e05319581aa572414231fe1e40f02f809d6330c26a9e632 --output type=oci,dest=/tmp/derived,tar=false; python3 /usr/local/lib/frames.py emit /tmp/derived /tmp/derived.frames
